g.text: EXPECTED STRUCTURE: TWO CHROMOSOMES, SO CHECK THE ASSEMBLY AGAINST THEM
Illustrative schematic, not real data. Sizes: N16961, 2,961,146 + 1,072,314 bp (Heidelberg et al., 2000).
ASSEMBLY QUALITY CONTROL: METRICS, SPECIES-SPECIFIC THRESHOLDS AND VERDICT
Check on 13,049 genomes: 11,080 PASS, 1,411 WARN, 558 FAIL
PASS: between the WARN bounds. WARN: between a WARN bound and its
FAIL bound. FAIL: beyond a FAIL bound. Dash: no bound.
Interpret with caution and flag for
Beyond a FAIL bound: exclude from
Caveat: QualiBact thresholds come from short-read (SPAdes-style) draft assemblies, so contig count and N50 do not suit
complete long-read assemblies. QualiBact notes that outliers stretch the FAIL bounds. Check the live page.
SPECIES CONFIRMATION: BEFORE ANY DOWNSTREAM ANALYSIS
Input: sequencing reads or assembled contigs
May not meet the quality standards of surveillance
Even good data, and especially assemblies, are estimates
of a genome, not definitive truth.
